title: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB: An Open and Efficient Small Language Model for Fast Conversational Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.20771v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB, an open and efficient small language model further post-trained from Gemma-4-E4B-it and optimized for speed and intelligence per GB of memory used for fast conversational agents. The model carries forward Gemma's strong conversational capabilities and further improves multi-turn tool use, instruction following, and input grounding for fast, local voice/device assistants, interactive personas, and embedded/Edge interfaces. The model combines natural conversation with multi-turn agentic capabilities to power voice/device assistants, interactive characters and robotic/IoT interfaces running on GeForce RTX, Jetson, and RTX/DGX Spark. Experiments on 21 benchmarks show that Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB achieves the highest average accuracy while generating the fewest output tokens in both reasoning and non-reasoning modes, compared with Gemma-4-E4B-it and Qwen3.5-4B. The model is released with a DFlash dr

translated_title: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB：一个面向快速对话代理的开放高效小型语言模型
translated_abstract: 我们介绍了Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB，这是一个开放且高效的小型语言模型，从Gemma-4-E4B-it进一步后训练而来，针对速度和每GB内存所提供的智能进行了优化，专用于快速对话代理。该模型延续了Gemma强大的对话能力，并进一步改进了多轮工具使用、指令遵循和输入接地能力，适用于快速的本地语音/设备助手、交互式角色以及嵌入式/边缘接口。该模型将自然对话与多轮智能体能力相结合，为运行在GeForce RTX、Jetson和RTX/DGX Spark上的语音/设备助手、交互式角色以及机器人/物联网接口提供支持。在21个基准测试上的实验表明，与Gemma-4-E4B-it和Qwen3.5-4B相比，Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB在推理和非推理两种模式下均实现了最高的平均准确率，同时生成的输出token数量最少。该模型随DFlash dr（摘要此处被截断）
tldr: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB是一个从Gemma-4-E4B-it后训练而来的开放高效小型语言模型，针对速度和每GB内存智能进行优化，在21个基准测试中相比Gemma-4-E4B-it和Qwen3.5-4B实现了最高平均准确率，同时生成最少的输出token。
en_tdlr: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB is an open, efficient small language model post-trained from Gemma-4-E4B-it and optimized for speed and intelligence per GB of memory, achieving the highest average accuracy while generating the fewest output tokens across 21 benchmarks compared with Gemma-4-E4B-it and Qwen3.5-4B.
